# Font, Title and Clear Menu Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the glyph-only menu (`2P`, `1P×1`, `1P×2`) with a big IMMIGRATION title and three modes written in full English (`2 PLAYERS`, `VS CPU  EASY`, `VS CPU  HARD`).

**Architecture:** The tile sheet generated by `tools/mktiles.py` grows from 32 to 128 slots (indices 0-19 unchanged) with 26 letters, 6 signs and 8 double-size title letters. Three pure functions in `src/core/view.c` (`view_text`, `view_title`, a rewritten `view_menu`) turn text into tile indices; they are host-tested. The console side keeps its menu loop; only the grid it draws changes.

**Tech Stack:** C89 (host: clang `-std=c89 -pedantic -Werror`; console: PVSnesLib 4.6.0 / 816-tcc), Python 3 for the tile generator, GNU Make.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-27-font-and-menu-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- `src/core/` never includes anything but `<string.h>` and core headers; no PVSnesLib, no `printf`, no `ctype.h`.
- Strict C89: no `//`, no declarations after statements, no `inline`, no compound literals, no designated initialisers, no `long long`, no floats.
- On the console `int` and `long` are 16 bits; RAM is not zeroed at boot; `static const` tables must be one-dimensional and file-scope to stay in ROM.
- Tile indices 0 to 19 keep their current meaning and pixels (board, HUD and result screen depend on them).
- On-screen text is English, uppercase, no accents.
- Commit format: `<gitmoji> [scope] <description>`, one gitmoji, scope among `[core]`, `[snes]`, `[tools]`, `[build]`, `[docs]`. Never name an assistant tool or AI.
- Menu layout (spec § 2): title rows 3-4, columns 5 to 26; mode rows 10, 12, 14; disc column 8; text from column 10. Labels exactly `2 PLAYERS`, `VS CPU  EASY` (two spaces), `VS CPU  HARD` (two spaces).

## Review Focus

- `view_text` with `width <= 0` must write nothing and return 0 (callers compute widths). — Task 1 test.
- Lowercase letters and any byte outside the mapped set become `TILE_EMPTY`, never an out-of-range tile index. — Task 1 test.
- `view_menu` with `selected` outside 0..2 (e.g. -1, 3) draws no disc and still draws everything else. — Task 3 test.
- Regenerating the sheet must leave tiles 0-19 byte-identical, or the board/HUD silently change. — Task 2 check.
- The title and the mode rows must not overlap, and nothing else on the grid may be non-empty. — Task 3 test (full-grid scan).

## File Structure

| File | Change | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| `src/core/view.h` | modify | new tile constants; `view_text`, `view_title` prototypes; updated `view_menu` comment |
| `src/core/view.c` | modify | `view_text`, `view_title`, new `view_menu` layout |
| `tests/test_view.c` | modify | tests for the three functions; old menu tests replaced |
| `tools/mktiles.py` | modify | 128-slot sheet: letters, signs, big title letters |

| `README.md`, `docs/screenshots/menu.png`, `docs/snes-notes.md` | modify | mode names, new menu capture, sheet size |

`src/snes/screens.c` does not change: it already calls `view_menu(selected, grid)` with `selected` in 0..2 and hands the grid to `render_board_from_grid`.

```c
/* Écrit la chaîne `s` en indices de tuiles dans out[0..width-1].
   'A'..'Z' donnent les lettres, '0'..'9' les chiffres, - . ! ? : ' leurs
   signes ; tout autre caractère (espace et minuscules compris) donne
   TILE_EMPTY. Les cases au-delà de la chaîne sont mises à TILE_EMPTY ; une
   chaîne plus longue que `width` est tronquée. Rien n'est écrit si
   width <= 0. Rend le nombre de caractères de `s` écrits. */
int view_text(const char *s, u8 *out, int width);
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement `view_text` in `src/core/view.c`**

Add before `menu_rows`:

```c
static u8 text_tile(char c)
{
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return (u8)(TILE_LETTER_A + (c - 'A'));
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return (u8)(TILE_DIGIT0 + (c - '0'));
    switch (c) {
    case '-':  return TILE_DASH;
    case '.':  return TILE_DOT;
    case '!':  return TILE_EXCL;
    case '?':  return TILE_QUEST;
    case ':':  return TILE_COLON;
    case '\'': return TILE_APOS;
    default:   return TILE_EMPTY;
    }
}

int view_text(const char *s, u8 *out, int width)
{
    int i = 0, n;
    while (i < width && s[i] != '\0') {
        out[i] = text_tile(s[i]);
        i++;
    }
    n = i;
    while (i < width) {
        out[i] = TILE_EMPTY;
        i++;
    }
    return n;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Add the big-letter builder and extend the tile list**

After `glyph()`:

```python
def big_glyph(ch, colour):
    """Lettre 5x7 agrandie x2 (10x14) dans un bloc 16x16, rendue en quatre
    tuiles : haut-gauche, haut-droite, bas-gauche, bas-droite."""
    block = [[0] * 16 for _ in range(16)]
    for y, row in enumerate(FONT[ch]):
        for x, c in enumerate(row):
            if c == '#':
                for dy in (0, 1):
                    for dx in (0, 1):
                        block[1 + 2 * y + dy][3 + 2 * x + dx] = colour
    quads = []
    for oy, ox in ((0, 0), (0, 8), (8, 0), (8, 8)):
        quads.append([block[oy + y][ox:ox + 8] for y in range(8)])
    return quads
```

In `tests/test_view.c`, delete `test_le_menu_affiche_les_trois_modes` and `test_le_menu_marque_la_ligne_choisie` and their two `T_RUN` lines. Add:

```c
/* Tuile attendue pour la lettre k (ordre I M G R A T O N) et le quart q. */
#define BIG(k, q) (TILE_BIG_BASE + 4 * (k) + (q))

static const int title_k[11] = { 0, 1, 1, 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, 6, 7 };   /* IMMIGRATION */

static void check_title(void)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        T_EQ(grid[3][5 + 2 * i],     BIG(title_k[i], 0));
        T_EQ(grid[3][5 + 2 * i + 1], BIG(title_k[i], 1));
        T_EQ(grid[4][5 + 2 * i],     BIG(title_k[i], 2));
        T_EQ(grid[4][5 + 2 * i + 1], BIG(title_k[i], 3));
    }
}

/* Vérifie un libellé à partir de la colonne 10 : lettre, chiffre ou vide. */
static void check_label(int row, const char *s)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; s[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        if (s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z')
            T_EQ(grid[row][10 + i], TILE_LETTER_A + (s[i] - 'A'));
        else if (s[i] >= '0' && s[i] <= '9')
            T_EQ(grid[row][10 + i], TILE_DIGIT0 + (s[i] - '0'));
        else
            T_EQ(grid[row][10 + i], TILE_EMPTY);
    }
}

static void test_le_titre_s_ecrit_en_grand(void)
{
    int x, y;
    for (y = 0; y < BOARD_H; y++)
        for (x = 0; x < BOARD_W; x++)
            grid[y][x] = TILE_EMPTY;
    view_title(grid);
    check_title();
    T_EQ(grid[3][4], TILE_EMPTY);
    T_EQ(grid[3][27], TILE_EMPTY);
    T_EQ(grid[2][10], TILE_EMPTY);
    T_EQ(grid[5][10], TILE_EMPTY);
}

static void test_le_menu_affiche_titre_et_modes(void)
{
    view_menu(0, grid);
    check_title();
    check_label(10, "2 PLAYERS");
    check_label(12, "VS CPU  EASY");
    check_label(14, "VS CPU  HARD");
}

static void test_le_menu_marque_la_ligne_choisie(void)
{
    view_menu(0, grid);
    T_EQ(grid[10][8], TILE_PIP_ON);
    T_EQ(grid[12][8], TILE_EMPTY);
    T_EQ(grid[14][8], TILE_EMPTY);
    view_menu(2, grid);
    T_EQ(grid[10][8], TILE_EMPTY);
    T_EQ(grid[14][8], TILE_PIP_ON);
}

static void test_le_menu_hors_bornes_n_a_pas_de_disque(void)
{
    view_menu(-1, grid);
    T_EQ(grid[10][8], TILE_EMPTY);
    T_EQ(grid[12][8], TILE_EMPTY);
    T_EQ(grid[14][8], TILE_EMPTY);
    check_label(12, "VS CPU  EASY");
    view_menu(3, grid);
    T_EQ(grid[14][8], TILE_EMPTY);
}

static void test_le_menu_ne_dessine_rien_d_autre(void)
{
    int x, y, n = 0;
    for (y = 0; y < BOARD_H; y++)
        for (x = 0; x < BOARD_W; x++)
            grid[y][x] = 0x55;                      /* RAM non remise à zéro */
    view_menu(1, grid);
    for (y = 0; y < BOARD_H; y++)
        for (x = 0; x < BOARD_W; x++)
            if (grid[y][x] != TILE_EMPTY) n++;
    /* 44 tuiles de titre + 1 disque + 8 + 9 + 9 caractères non blancs */
    T_EQ(n, 44 + 1 + 8 + 9 + 9);
}
```

Note on the last count: `2 PLAYERS` has 8 non-space characters (`2PLAYERS`), `VS CPU  EASY` and `VS CPU  HARD` have 9 each (`VSCPUEASY`, `VSCPUHARD`).

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement in `src/core/view.c`**

Replace `menu_rows` and the whole old `view_menu` with:

```c
/* Tables à une dimension et de portée fichier : elles restent en ROM
   (docs/snes-notes.md § 10). */
static const u8 menu_rows[3] = { 10, 12, 14 };
/* IMMIGRATION : rang de chaque lettre dans l'ordre I M G R A T O N des
   lettres agrandies de la planche. */
static const u8 title_letters[11] = { 0, 1, 1, 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, 6, 7 };

void view_title(u8 out[BOARD_H][BOARD_W])
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        u8 t = (u8)(TILE_BIG_BASE + 4 * title_letters[i]);
        int x = 5 + 2 * i;
        out[3][x]     = t;
        out[3][x + 1] = (u8)(t + 1);
        out[4][x]     = (u8)(t + 2);
        out[4][x + 1] = (u8)(t + 3);
    }
}

void view_menu(int selected, u8 out[BOARD_H][BOARD_W])
{
    int x, y, i;

    for (y = 0; y < BOARD_H; y++) {
        for (x = 0; x < BOARD_W; x++) {
            out[y][x] = TILE_EMPTY;
        }
    }
    view_title(out);
    view_text("2 PLAYERS",    &out[menu_rows[0]][10], BOARD_W - 10);
    view_text("VS CPU  EASY", &out[menu_rows[1]][10], BOARD_W - 10);
    view_text("VS CPU  HARD", &out[menu_rows[2]][10], BOARD_W - 10);
    for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        out[menu_rows[i]][8] = (u8)((i == selected) ? TILE_PIP_ON : TILE_EMPTY);
    }
}
```

```markdown
## 11. Tile sheet layout

`tools/mktiles.py` generates `data/tiles.bmp`, 128 × 64 pixels, 128 slots of 8 × 8. Indices 0-19 are the board, HUD and result tiles and never move. 20-45 are the letters A-Z, 46-51 the signs `- . ! ? : '`, 52-83 the title letters `I M G R A T O N` at double size (4 tiles each: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), 84-127 are free. The whole sheet is 4 KB of VRAM, from word address 0x4000 to 0x47FF. `view_text()` in `src/core/view.c` maps characters to these indices.
```
